items.name: NODE_ENV
items.rotationPolicy: not-applicable; review on environment promotion
items.validationMode: offline enum and production fail-fast review
items.notes: Production must use the production enum; this item carries no runtime value.

items.name: PORT
items.rotationPolicy: not-applicable; review on topology change
items.notes: Internal listener only; the production artifact currently documents a non-public backend port.

items.name: DATABASE_URL
items.rotationPolicy: rotate at most every 90 days and immediately after exposure or workload change
items.validationMode: presence-only through secret manager metadata; never render or print
items.notes: Connection secret supplied at runtime; evidence records only present or missing.

items.name: JWT_SECRET
items.rotationPolicy: rotate at most every 90 days with controlled session invalidation
items.validationMode: presence and policy result only; never render, hash, prefix or print
items.notes: Production must reject development placeholders and weak material.

items.name: FRONTEND_ORIGIN
items.rotationPolicy: not-applicable; review on ingress or hostname change
items.validationMode: offline origin-shape review followed by future HTTPS/CORS validation
items.notes: Single approved origin used by the backend CORS policy; no planned URL is materialized here.

items.name: COOKIE_SECURE
items.rotationPolicy: not-applicable; review on authentication topology change
items.validationMode: offline assertion that production Compose forces secure cookies
items.notes: Must remain enabled for future HTTPS production.

items.name: COOKIE_SAME_SITE
items.rotationPolicy: not-applicable; review with SSO and CSRF policy
items.validationMode: offline enum review and future browser authentication validation
items.notes: Select deliberately for the approved SSO and frontend topology.

items.name: LOG_LEVEL
items.rotationPolicy: not-applicable; review on incident or observability change
items.notes: Logging policy must not enable raw secrets, prompts, provider payloads or MCP payloads.

items.name: DEV_LOGIN_ENABLED
items.rotationPolicy: not-applicable; review on authentication change
items.notes: Development login must remain disabled outside explicitly local development.

items.name: VITE_API_BASE_URL
items.rotationPolicy: not-applicable; rebuild and review on topology change
items.validationMode: offline public URL or relative-path review
items.notes: Public bundle configuration. It must never contain credentials or a secret-bearing URL.

items.name: VITE_APP_NAME
items.rotationPolicy: not-applicable; review on branding change
items.notes: Public display value only.

items.name: VITE_APP_ENV
items.rotationPolicy: not-applicable; review on promotion
items.notes: Public environment label; it is not an authorization control.

items.name: VITE_USE_MOCKS
items.rotationPolicy: not-applicable; review on release
items.validationMode: offline exact false assertion for production
items.notes: Public flag that must not enable mocks in production.

items.name: VITE_ENABLE_DEMO_MODE
items.rotationPolicy: not-applicable; review on release
items.notes: Public feature flag; never use as a security boundary.

items.name: VITE_MOCK_DELAY_MS
items.rotationPolicy: not-applicable; review with local mock behavior
items.notes: Public local-development setting; production mocks remain disabled.

items.name: VITE_MOCK_SCENARIO
items.rotationPolicy: not-applicable; review with local mock fixtures
items.notes: Public local-development setting; it must not carry private fixture data.

items.name: VITE_ENABLE_PWA
items.rotationPolicy: not-applicable; review on release and cache-policy change
items.validationMode: offline feature-flag and service-worker policy review
items.notes: Public feature flag; enabling it requires a separate cache and update review.

items.name: VITE_DEFAULT_LOCALE
items.rotationPolicy: not-applicable; review on localization change
items.notes: Public presentation preference only.

items.name: VITE_DEFAULT_TIMEZONE
items.rotationPolicy: not-applicable; review on regional policy change
items.notes: Public presentation preference only; server timestamps remain authoritative.

items.name: POSTGRES_DB
items.rotationPolicy: not-applicable; change only through approved database migration plan
items.notes: Database identifier only; must not embed credentials.

items.name: POSTGRES_USER
items.rotationPolicy: review every 90 days and on privilege or workload change
items.notes: Non-human workload identity; permissions are evidence, not the password.

items.name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
items.rotationPolicy: rotate at most every 90 days and immediately after exposure or role change
items.validationMode: presence-only through secret manager metadata; never render or print
items.notes: Required when the Compose-managed database is used; an external database may use an approved equivalent.

items.name: MICROSOFT_SSO_ENABLED
items.rotationPolicy: not-applicable; enable only through approved SSO change
items.validationMode: offline exact false assertion until SSO homologation
items.notes: Enabling this gate makes the client, tenant, secret and redirect set conditionally required.

items.name: MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID
items.rotationPolicy: review annually and on app registration replacement
items.validationMode: offline UUID-shape and app-registration ownership review
items.notes: Conditionally required when Microsoft SSO is enabled; not a credential by itself.

items.name: MICROSOFT_CLIENT_SECRET
items.rotationPolicy: rotate before provider expiry and at most every 180 days; revoke immediately after exposure
items.validationMode: presence and expiry metadata only; never render or print
items.notes: Conditionally required when Microsoft SSO is enabled; a certificate may replace it through a future approved design.

items.name: MICROSOFT_TENANT_ID
items.rotationPolicy: review annually and on tenant or app-registration change
items.notes: Conditionally required when Microsoft SSO is enabled.

items.name: MICROSOFT_REDIRECT_URI
items.rotationPolicy: not-applicable; review on hostname, proxy or route change
items.validationMode: offline HTTPS URI/path review and future IdP equality check
items.notes: Conditionally required; planned hostnames are not materialized as runtime values in this inventory.

items.name: MICROSOFT_POST_LOGOUT_REDIRECT_URI
items.rotationPolicy: not-applicable; review on hostname or login-flow change
items.validationMode: offline HTTPS URI review and future IdP equality check
items.notes: Conditionally required when Microsoft SSO is enabled.

items.name: MICROSOFT_ALLOWED_DOMAINS
items.rotationPolicy: review quarterly and on organization-domain change
items.notes: Optional defense-in-depth allowlist; it does not replace tenant validation.

items.name: MICROSOFT_ALLOWED_TENANT_IDS
items.rotationPolicy: review quarterly and on federation change
items.notes: Explicit tenant allowlist when multi-tenant behavior is approved.

items.name: MICROSOFT_SSO_AUTO_LINK_BY_EMAIL
items.rotationPolicy: not-applicable; change only after account-takeover review
items.validationMode: offline exact false assertion until specifically approved
items.notes: Email auto-linking remains disabled by default.

items.name: LLM_PROVIDERS_ENABLED
items.rotationPolicy: not-applicable; enable only through approved provider change
items.notes: Top-level provider gate; remains disabled in 17C.

items.name: LLM_EXECUTION_ENABLED
items.rotationPolicy: not-applicable; enable only through approved execution change
items.notes: Independent execution gate; provider configuration alone never authorizes execution.

items.name: OPENAI_ENABLED
items.rotationPolicy: not-applicable; enable only after provider go/no-go
items.notes: OpenAI provider registration remains disabled.

items.name: OPENAI_EXECUTION_ENABLED
items.rotationPolicy: not-applicable; enable only after provider go/no-go
items.notes: OpenAI outbound execution remains disabled.

items.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
items.rotationPolicy: rotate at most every 90 days and immediately after exposure or anomalous spend
items.validationMode: presence-only in provider secret store; never render or print
items.notes: Conditionally required only after OpenAI enable and execution gates are approved.

items.name: OPENAI_BASE_URL
items.rotationPolicy: not-applicable; review on provider routing change
items.validationMode: offline HTTPS origin/path and egress review
items.notes: Conditionally required provider endpoint; no operational value is stored here.

items.name: OPENAI_DEFAULT_MODEL
items.rotationPolicy: review on model version, pricing or policy change
items.notes: Conditionally required when OpenAI execution is enabled.

items.name: AZURE_OPENAI_ENABLED
items.rotationPolicy: not-applicable; enable only after provider go/no-go
items.notes: Azure OpenAI provider registration remains disabled.

items.name: AZURE_OPENAI_EXECUTION_ENABLED
items.rotationPolicy: not-applicable; enable only after provider go/no-go
items.notes: Azure OpenAI outbound execution remains disabled.

items.name: AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY
items.rotationPolicy: rotate at most every 90 days and immediately after exposure or anomalous spend
items.validationMode: presence-only in provider secret store; never render or print
items.notes: Conditionally required only after Azure OpenAI gates are approved.

items.name: AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT
items.rotationPolicy: not-applicable; review on Azure resource or region change
items.validationMode: offline HTTPS origin and approved-resource review
items.notes: Conditionally required; no Azure resource endpoint is stored in this inventory.

items.name: AZURE_OPENAI_DEPLOYMENT
items.rotationPolicy: review on model deployment or version change
items.notes: Conditionally required when Azure OpenAI is enabled.

items.name: AZURE_OPENAI_API_VERSION
items.rotationPolicy: review on provider deprecation or compatibility change
items.notes: Conditionally required when Azure OpenAI is enabled.

items.name: ANTHROPIC_ENABLED
items.rotationPolicy: not-applicable; enable only after provider go/no-go
items.notes: Anthropic provider registration remains disabled.

items.name: ANTHROPIC_EXECUTION_ENABLED
items.rotationPolicy: not-applicable; enable only after provider go/no-go
items.notes: Anthropic outbound execution remains disabled.

items.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
items.rotationPolicy: rotate at most every 90 days and immediately after exposure or anomalous spend
items.validationMode: presence-only in provider secret store; never render or print
items.notes: Conditionally required only after Anthropic gates are approved.

items.name: ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL
items.rotationPolicy: not-applicable; review on provider routing change
items.validationMode: offline HTTPS origin and egress review
items.notes: Conditionally required provider endpoint; no operational value is stored here.

items.name: ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_MODEL
items.rotationPolicy: review on model version, pricing or policy change
items.notes: Conditionally required when Anthropic execution is enabled.

items.name: EMBEDDINGS_ENABLED
items.rotationPolicy: not-applicable; enable only after embeddings go/no-go
items.notes: Embedding provider selection remains disabled.

items.name: EMBEDDINGS_EXECUTION_ENABLED
items.rotationPolicy: not-applicable; enable only after embeddings go/no-go
items.notes: External embedding execution remains disabled.

items.name: EMBEDDINGS_PROVIDER
items.rotationPolicy: review on provider or data-residency change
items.notes: Uses the selected provider credential; no separate embeddings key exists in the current backend schema.

items.name: EMBEDDINGS_MODEL
items.rotationPolicy: review on model, dimension or retrieval-policy change
items.notes: Conditionally required when embeddings execution is enabled.

items.name: EMBEDDINGS_DIMENSION
items.rotationPolicy: review on model or vector-schema compatibility change
items.notes: Changing dimension can require a separately approved data migration.

items.name: AGNO_ENABLED
items.rotationPolicy: not-applicable; enable only through approved runtime change
items.notes: Agno integration remains disabled.

items.name: AGNO_EXECUTION_ENABLED
items.rotationPolicy: not-applicable; enable only through approved runtime execution change
items.notes: Agno execution remains independently disabled.

items.name: RUNTIME_ALLOW_EXTERNAL_TOOLS
items.rotationPolicy: not-applicable; enable only after tool-specific authorization
items.notes: Global external-tool gate remains disabled.

items.name: AGNO_RUNTIME_HTTP_ENABLED
items.rotationPolicy: not-applicable; enable only through approved bridge change
items.notes: Conditionally enables the authenticated runtime channel, not tools or providers.

items.name: AGNO_RUNTIME_HTTP_BASE_URL
items.rotationPolicy: not-applicable; review on service topology change
items.validationMode: offline private-service URL and allowlist review
items.notes: Conditionally required when the HTTP runtime is enabled; no operational endpoint is stored here.

items.name: AGNO_RUNTIME_HTTP_REQUIRE_SECURITY_KEY
items.rotationPolicy: not-applicable; must remain enabled for non-local bridge traffic
items.validationMode: offline exact true assertion in production artifacts
items.notes: Requires the runtime channel secret when the bridge is enabled.

items.name: AGNO_RUNTIME_HTTP_SECURITY_KEY
items.rotationPolicy: rotate at most every 90 days and immediately after exposure or workload change
items.validationMode: presence-only on both workloads; never compare by printing
items.notes: Conditionally required when the authenticated HTTP runtime is enabled.

items.name: AGNO_RUNTIME_HTTP_TOOLS_ENABLED
items.rotationPolicy: not-applicable; enable only after tool authorization
items.notes: Runtime tool descriptors and execution remain disabled.

items.name: AGNO_RUNTIME_HTTP_MAX_TOOL_CALLS
items.rotationPolicy: not-applicable; review with every tool-policy change
items.validationMode: offline exact zero assertion while tools are disabled
items.notes: Zero is the fail-closed limit for 17C.

items.name: AGNO_RUNTIME_HTTP_TOOL_GATEWAY_ENABLED
items.rotationPolicy: not-applicable; enable only after gateway authorization
items.notes: Tool gateway remains disabled independently of the bridge.

items.name: AGNO_BRIDGE_EXECUTION_MODE
items.rotationPolicy: not-applicable; approve every transition from stub
items.notes: The bridge remains in stub mode until a provider-specific phase is approved.

items.name: AGNO_BRIDGE_PROVIDER
items.rotationPolicy: review on provider selection or contract change
items.notes: Provider selection does not enable execution.

items.name: AGNO_BRIDGE_ALLOWED_MODELS
items.rotationPolicy: review on model, pricing or safety-policy change
items.notes: Conditionally required for real bridge provider mode.

items.name: AGNO_RUNTIME_HTTP_HOST
items.rotationPolicy: not-applicable; review on network topology change
items.notes: Bridge listener bind; exposure remains internal to the approved network.

items.name: AGNO_RUNTIME_HTTP_PORT
items.rotationPolicy: not-applicable; review on topology change
items.notes: Bridge internal listener port.

items.name: AGNO_RUNTIME_HTTP_RAG_CONTEXT_ENABLED
items.rotationPolicy: not-applicable; enable only after data-flow approval
items.validationMode: offline exact false assertion in bridge example and Compose
items.notes: RAG context forwarding is a separate data-governance decision.

items.name: ORCHESTRA_TOOL_GATEWAY_URL
items.rotationPolicy: not-applicable; review on gateway topology change
items.notes: Conditionally required only after tool gateway approval; no operational endpoint is stored here.

items.name: AGNO_TELEMETRY
items.rotationPolicy: not-applicable; enable only after telemetry data-flow approval
items.notes: External bridge telemetry remains disabled.

items.name: MCP_REMOTE_ENABLED
items.rotationPolicy: not-applicable; enable only after MCP go/no-go
items.notes: Top-level remote MCP gate remains disabled.

items.name: MCP_REMOTE_EXECUTION_ENABLED
items.rotationPolicy: not-applicable; enable only for an approved execution window
items.notes: Remote MCP execution remains disabled.

items.name: MCP_REMOTE_DISCOVERY_ENABLED
items.rotationPolicy: not-applicable; enable only for approved discovery
items.notes: Remote discovery remains disabled.

items.name: MCP_REMOTE_READONLY_ENABLED
items.rotationPolicy: not-applicable; enable only for approved read-only tool scope
items.notes: Read-only is necessary but does not independently authorize execution.

items.name: MCP_REMOTE_EGRESS_ALLOWLIST
items.rotationPolicy: review quarterly and on every connector origin change
items.validationMode: offline empty assertion followed by future exact-origin review
items.notes: Remains empty in 17C; operational origins are not stored in this inventory.

items.name: MCP_REMOTE_ALLOW_WRITE_TOOLS
items.rotationPolicy: not-applicable; write tools require a separate risk phase
items.notes: Write tools remain prohibited.

items.name: MCP_REMOTE_REQUIRE_SECRET_REF
items.rotationPolicy: not-applicable; must remain enabled for authenticated remote MCP
items.notes: Authenticated servers must use logical server-side secret references.

items.name: MCP_CORPORATE_READONLY_ENABLED
items.rotationPolicy: not-applicable; enable only in a supervised approved window
items.notes: Corporate status adapter remains disabled.

items.name: MCP_CORPORATE_READONLY_ALLOWED_ORIGIN
items.rotationPolicy: review on every application hostname or connector change
items.validationMode: offline empty assertion followed by future exact HTTPS origin review
items.notes: Conditionally required only for approved corporate read-only execution; no operational origin is stored here.

items.name: MCP_CORPORATE_READONLY_SECRET_REF
items.rotationPolicy: review whenever the referenced credential or workload identity rotates
items.validationMode: offline logical-reference format only; never resolve the referenced value
items.notes: Logical future reference in the env://ORCHESTRA_CORPORATE_READONLY_<PURPOSE> namespace; it is not the credential.

items.name: ORCHESTRA_FRONTEND_BIND_ADDRESS
items.rotationPolicy: not-applicable; review on ingress or host-network topology change
items.notes: Versioned default remains loopback; any future override belongs to approved deployment configuration.

items.name: ORCHESTRA_FRONTEND_PORT
items.rotationPolicy: not-applicable; review on ingress or host-network topology change
items.notes: Host publication setting; backend, database and bridge remain internal.

items.name: ORCHESTRA_FRONTEND_IMAGE
items.rotationPolicy: replace with each approved release and retain the rollback digest
items.validationMode: offline immutable-digest format and release-approval review
items.notes: Future operational reference; local image placeholder remains in versioned examples.

items.name: ORCHESTRA_BACKEND_IMAGE
items.rotationPolicy: replace with each approved release and retain the rollback digest
items.validationMode: offline immutable-digest format and release-approval review
items.notes: Future operational reference; no registry credential or signed URL is allowed.

items.name: ORCHESTRA_MIGRATE_IMAGE
items.rotationPolicy: replace with each approved schema release and retain compatibility evidence
items.notes: Used only by the one-shot operations profile in a future approved window.

items.name: ORCHESTRA_AGNO_BRIDGE_IMAGE
items.rotationPolicy: replace with each approved bridge release and retain the rollback digest
items.notes: Conditionally required only if the opt-in bridge profile is approved.

items.name: ORCHESTRA_BACKUP_ID
items.rotationPolicy: new immutable identifier for every approved backup cycle
items.validationMode: offline sanitized identifier, retention and completion-status review
items.notes: Must not contain a storage URL, path, credential or backup contents.

items.name: ORCHESTRA_RESTORE_TEST_ID
items.rotationPolicy: new immutable identifier for every restore exercise
items.validationMode: offline sanitized identifier, timestamp and pass-or-fail review
items.notes: Evidence reference only; no data or storage location.

items.name: ORCHESTRA_CHANGE_ID
items.rotationPolicy: new immutable identifier for each deployment window
items.validationMode: offline sanitized identifier and approval-state review
items.notes: Change-system reference only; no secret, endpoint or signed link.

items.name: ORCHESTRA_ROLLBACK_RELEASE_ID
items.rotationPolicy: update on every successful release after rollback readiness is confirmed
items.validationMode: offline sanitized release identifier and digest-link review
items.notes: Identifies the approved previous release without embedding credentials or endpoints.

items.name: ORCHESTRA_DEPLOY_OWNER
items.rotationPolicy: review for every deployment window and on-call handoff
items.validationMode: offline approved role or internal identifier review
items.notes: Use a role or approved internal identifier, not personal contact data or a credential.
